text:
clara (Marketing): Hey team — tiny but urgent creative sprint: need a reusable micro-launch kit for the webinar and inbound plays. Single-sheet that scales: desktop hero, mobile crop, and square social tile. Keep copy minimal. Two messaging lanes: latency-first and cost-first.

diego (Design): Got it. What final crops and exports? SVG + PNG? Any motion?

clara (Marketing): Exports: SVG master + png @2x for each crop. Crops: 1200x600 (desktop), 640x360 (mobile), 800x800 (social). Also need a 3-frame micro-GIF of the sparkline (loop).

tara (Growth): Add a brand-only variant (no CTA) for lift tests and a transparent PNG for overlays. We'll want two CTAs per layout for A/B: "Try benchmark" and "See pricing".

diego (Design): Planning two layouts: stats-first (big stat + sparkline) and story-first (short sentence + supporting stat). Two colorways: brand blue and dark invert. Modular badge slot for "Dedicated" / "SLA".

meera (Legal): Quick compliance note: avoid absolutes like "cheapest" or "always". Use qualifiers: "up to" or "on typical workloads". Include a tiny methodology footnote with link. I can sign off quickly if copy is short.

clara (Marketing): Copy constraints: headline 5	6 words, subhead 102 words. Pull conservative numbers from the sheet "Q4-webinar-bench v2". Add two headline options for each lane.

diego (Design): Will add copy slate file with approved CTAs and methodology footnote. Also include a version with the sparkline as a subtle SVG animation for the landing page. GIF for ad buys.

tara (Growth): Can we also get a tiny variant where the stat is replaced by a short testimonial line (one sentence)? might help conversion testing.

diego (Design): Yes — will provide a testimonial slot mock. Deliverables list: 2 layouts x 2 headlines x 2 colorways x 3 crops + transparent PNG + gif + svg animation + README + copy slate.

assets-bot: uploaded draft_pack_v1.zip to /Shared/marketing/micro-launch-kit/draft_pack_v1.zip (contains fig, exports, README).

clara (Marketing): Timeline: initial mocks by tomorrow 11:00, review at 11:30, final assets by EOD Tuesday. I'll create a short review checklist and tag reviewers.

meera (Legal): Ping me when copy is attached and final. I can review within ~1 hour. Please avoid unqualified superlatives.

diego (Design): Figma draft: https://www.figma.com/file/unique123/micro-launch-kit-draft	6 org access. Will post updates in thread as I iterate. :sparkles:
